name: pg_copy2_validation_copy_force
subject: Fix validation of COPY FORCE_NOT_NULL/FORCE_NULL for the all-column cases
goal:
COPY's FORCE_NOT_NULL and FORCE_NULL take either a column list or `*` for every column. Written with a column list they are rejected outside CSV mode and rejected in COPY TO. Written as `*` they are accepted in both, where they mean nothing. FORCE_QUOTE, which has the same two forms, is validated in both.

The all-column form has to be validated exactly like the column-list form. Every combination that is legal today must stay legal.
